## Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational problem and the implemented change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run config:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] UI changes include an end-to-end test or a clear manual verification description
- [ ] Database changes include a new migration

## Compatibility

- [ ] Inventory schema version 1 remains backward compatible
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where necessary
- [ ] English and German UI text are updated where necessary
- [ ] No credentials, private hostnames or environment-specific data are included
